Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Rishabh - 8 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Sunita - 38 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The fishermen's village - boats, nets, coconut palms

Scene 1: The fishermen's village - Day

[Rishabh stands in the village. Sunita stands near him.]

Sunita: "Today feels like a good day."

[Waves crash against the shore.]

Sunita: "I really enjoyed today."
